name: Inbound Per Minute
query:
SELECT
	DATE_FORMAT(i.creation, '%%Y-%%m-%%d %%H:%%i') AS "Minute:Data:140",
	i.integration_request_service AS "Channel:Data:140",
	i.status AS "Status:Data:100",
	COUNT(*) AS "Deliveries:Int:100"
FROM `tabIntegration Request` i FORCE INDEX (creation)
WHERE i.creation >= %(from_date)s AND i.creation < %(to_date)s + INTERVAL 1 DAY
GROUP BY 1, 2, 3
ORDER BY 1 DESC, 4 DESC
